run_train_model: run the TTAD transformer model training loop with argparse CLI flags for data_dir, output_dir, and num_epochs
run_validate_model: run validation on the TTAD encoder-decoder model using SequentialSampler and compute loss and accuracy metrics
run_eval_model_on_dataset: run evaluation of the TTAD encoder-decoder model on a specified validation dataset dtype and log results
run_generate_model_name: run generate_model_name to create a unique model identifier string from training args and a unix timestamp
run_model_trainer_train: run the ModelTrainer train method to train an encoder-decoder model over multiple epochs with gradient clipping and hard example mining
